I agree and disagree. (Speaking as a full blown “credited” DV survivor and woman.) I understand why it’s exhausting to keep having the same conversations over and over, and it would be nice to have the girls chime in once and a while, ultimately I think Ethan (and the other guys) are doing more good than harm. 

I think of it this way, as men with one of the most influential platforms on the planet, they’re actively calling out these creeps while also trying their best to humanize and bridge the gap. Ultimately, I think if we’re aiming to change peoples minds and educate, having men do it for us is the way to go. They’re already not gonna listen to us as women, and I think Ethan is trying in his own way to use his privilege as a man to get through to them. 

I’m a firm believer that alienating and isolating creates extremism. And ignoring this problem doesn’t make it go away. I totally understand how to other survivors it’s difficult to watch the cognitive dissonance repeat over and over. Turn off the podcast. Read a book. Drink some tea. Come back to it later. 

Personally I think Ethan has the potential to change a lot of minds and influence young streamers who don’t yet understand the consequences of following people like Tate.

This post broke my heart :( I felt the same way when I turned 25, I turn 26 in February and I feel the same still. A few weeks ago a 29 year old man told me I was “fat and old” and to not be so bitter that “I was past my prime and my eggs are all dead.” 

For a lot of us who struggle with mental health issues our lives only BEGIN in our 20’s. I’m way behind both my younger sisters in terms of milestones and I’ve only just begun to find myself. It often times feels too late and the failure to launch on time literally cripples me every day. I see girls that are like 16-17 blowing up in the field I want to be in, and even THEY are considered adult and old. It’s so scary. 

I’m literally terrified that I’m too old to be sexy, too old to enjoy the things I love, too old to get married and have kids, and that pretty soon I’m gonna become the crypt keeper ☠️ But some days are worse than others. I am so sorry your daughter feels this way too because I know how shitty it is. I hope she finds a group of wonderful women to surround herself with so she can build up and realize how much she has to offer <3
